name: Eshana St. Cloud
source: A once proudly conservative-raised woman, turned wife and sex object by her Western sex-obsessed husband. Tempted by the low-hanging fruits he offered her, Eshana dove head first into a world of sexual liberation with bountiful experiences. Though once shy and reclusive to all forms of intimacy, she now welcomes all new challenges and experiences and hopes to embark on her lifestyle with her new neighbors next door. Be it with the wife, husband, or both, she could care less.
